articleTitle: Attention-YOLOX: Improvement in On-Road Object Detection by Introducing Attention Mechanisms to YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Deep learning-based Object detection methods have been widely used in autonomous driving in recent years. An object detection algorithm having high detection accuracy and speed is crucial to the safety of autonomous driving vehicles. In this paper, we propose Attention-YOLOX, which embeds an attention mechanism in the object detection algorithm YOLOX to improve the detection accuracy. We propose four models that provide attention mechanisms to capture the inter-channel relationship, the relationship between channel-wise and spatial features, and the long- distance dependency of features, which assist the model to accurately predict the class and location of the target object. We evaluated the effectiveness of the proposed methods on the KITTI, BDDIOOK, and SODAIOM datasets containing images of various scenes and visual conditions. We confirmed that our methods have better detection accuracy than YOLOX with no attention mechanism while maintaining a high processing speed.

articleTitle: A Buffer Algorithm of Flash Database Based on LRU
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Flash memory is a pure electronic device, which has the advantages of small size, high speed, low energy consumption, strong earthquake resistance, etc. It has gradually replaced the traditional hard disk in production and life. However, compared with the traditional hard disk, flash memory has the characteristics of erasing before writing, updating in different places, asymmetric read-write delay, etc. which makes the existing buffer algorithm for traditional mechanical hard disk unable to obtain better performance in flash memory database. This paper presents a buffer replacement algorithm for flash database-ASC-LRU. The algorithm has the following characteristics: (1) Based on the classification strategy and access frequency, the buffer is divided into cold clean list, cold dirty list, hot clean list and hot dirty list; (2) The length of each linked list is dynamically adjusted according to the citation frequency and clean state; (3) By setting the length threshold and identification bit, the problem that the newly entered clean page is quickly replaced and the hot page resident buffer is not used for a long time is solved. Through the comparative analysis of experimental results, it can be concluded that ASC-LRU algorithm has better performance than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Cooperative Target Recognition System Threat Assessment Based on Network Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: In threat assessment method, the relationships among indicators considering insufficiency and weights set unreasonable, the threat assessment method via network model put forward, used for coordinate target recognition system based on secondary radar. Firstly, the indicators were given by hierarchical structure, thinking of the relationships among indexes, then giving the indicators by network model. Then making standardization of indicators, solving the indicators weights by Analytic Network Process (ANP). Getting the systems' threat degree through threat degree assessment model, then made sequencing. Finally an example is used to verify the method, shows it is reasonable and effective. And the result is helping for allocation of interfere resources and operational deployment in later.

articleTitle: Construction of Library Information Retrieval System Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: To solve the problem of low recall in traditional fast information retrieval methods, this paper proposes a fast retrieval method of massive library information based on data mining technology and supported by distributed open source framework Hadoop. According to the requirements of library resources retrieval, the system framework is designed, and the retrieval algorithm is compiled by using data mining technology. Then, under the system architecture, the implementation process of the system and the retrieval mechanism of library resources in the distributed environment are determined. The performance of the system is tested by multiple sets of experimental data. Compared with other similar retrieval systems, the retrieval efficiency of the designed system has been significantly improved, and with the increase of data volume, the improvement efficiency will be more obvious.

articleTitle: Effects of Elastic Cable Parameters on Seismic Performance of Long-Span Suspension Bridges
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Based on a typical suspension bridge in China, the effects of elastic cable parameters on seismic performance were compared by using finite element analysis. In the longitudinal direction, elastic cables were set between the main girder and reaction pedestals to restrict the relative longitudinal displacement. A series of parameters of elastic cables were employed to compare and analyse the bridge response resulting in terms of the internal force and displacement including the main bridge and approach bridge using nonlinear time-history method. The results showed that the reasonable stiffness of elastic cables could obviously decrease the deck displacement, and the pounding phenomenon between adjacent structures had ability to be effectively avoided using elastic cable. Meanwhile, it also could decrease the internal forces of the fixed piers for the approach bridge, but slightly increased the internal forces and the top displacement of towers. Elastic cables are applied mainly to provide a structural system with elastic stiffness other than energy dissipation. Distribution inertial forces of the structural system are more reasonable by changing the transfer path of inertia forces. Finally, a general design principle of the reasonable elastic cables was summarized.

articleTitle: Size Measurement and Weight Estimation of Filter Screen Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Filter screens are widely used in automotive manufacturing. In order to solve the problem of low manual inspection efficiency and large measurement errors, a non-contact automatic measurement method based on machine vision is proposed. First, the filter screen image is captured by the camera, and the image is pre-processed using grayscale and binary segmentation to eliminate noise and extract the filter area; then the pixel size is extracted using XLD edge detection; later, the actual value of the filter size is measured by coordinate system conversion; finally, the weight of the filter is calculated by the hollow rate. The experiment shows that the measurement error of the diameter of the inner and outer circle of the bottom surface of the filter screen is within 0.1mm, and the measurement error of the weight is within 0.8g, which meets the need of dimensional measurement of the filter screen production.

Author Keywords: Measurement of inner and outer circle diameter

articleTitle: Research on Control of Three-Phase MMC Rectifier Optimized by Seagull Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: In this paper, an online self-tuning quasi proportional resonant controller based on the seagull optimization algorithm is proposed, and it is applied to the inner loop current control and circulating current suppression of Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC), which realizes the effective control when the grid voltage is unbalanced and the load changes. The simulation result obtained by Matlab/Simulinks shows that it has better dynamic performance and steady-state performance. Compared with quasi proportional resonant controller with fixed parameters, the overshoot of the AC current and circulating current based on the proposed controller is significantly decreased. The steady-state error of the circulating current is reduced by 50% under balance grid and 62.5% under unbalance grid.

articleTitle: Research on Load Quantification of Optical Cable in Power Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: With the continuous development of the scale of the power grid, the power communication network, as the second network of the power grid, its topology structure is constantly complicated safe and reliable operation. In this paper, the load quantification model of the network topology layer is established by using betweenness centrality from the perspective of network topology, and the load quantification model of the power business layer is established by using business importance from the perspective of power business. In the physical layer, the physical layer load quantification model is established by using the reliability of the optical cable. The TOPSIS method is used to obtain the comprehensive load quantification model of the power communication network. Finally, the simulation model is constructed and compared with other load quantification models to prove the accuracy of the proposed method. The research conclusions have certain guiding significance for the load quantification, risk protection and network optimization of the power communication network.

articleTitle: Coupled-Eulerian-Lagrangian Simulation of Sand Compaction Pile Installation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Sand compaction pile (SCP) is widely used in dealing with marine clay for the construction works. The process of its installation is so complex and its effects are so important, that ideally needed to be considered. Based on Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian approach, this paper proposes a numerical approach to investigate the SCP installation effects. This approach consists of casing penetration and sand compaction, which are simulated mainly by controlling rigid body movement and velocity of nodes. The results show that a good agreement exists when compared with the measured data of centrifuge tests. This approach might improve the predictive accuracy of pore pressure and ground upheaval when compared with the classical theory and simulation methods.

articleTitle: Runoff Forecast in Yangtze River Based on Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Long-term short-term Memory neural network (LSTM) was used to construct daily and monthly runoff prediction models at Yichang, Hankou, and Datong stations of the Yangtze River, and to evaluate the model performance with different parameters. The results showed that: (1) the accuracy of model with a forecast period of 1-3 days was higher, the Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency Coefficient (NSE) of daily runoff forecast of most hydrological stations can reach more than 0.95 when the forecast period is 1-3 days. When the forecast period was one month, LSTM had a high accuracy with NSE more than 0.70. (2) As the number of neurons and training increased, the forecast accuracy improved, but once the number of neurons and training reached a certain threshold, the accuracy tended to stabilize.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment Indexes of a New Type Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Reasonable evaluation of the safe operation is the basic requirement for operators to grasp the status of the power grid correctly. A large number of distributed generators are assessed to the distribution network, and reasonable indexes are needed to assess their risks. Considering the randomness of distributed generators, the semi-invariant method is adopted to calculate the voltage overrun risk assessment index and power flow overrun risk assessment index of the new type distribution network. A new type distribution network risk assessment index system is established, including voltage overrun risk assessment index, branch power flow overrun risk index, load loss risk assessment index and frequency overrun risk assessment index. The IEEE34 node distribution network cases prove that the voltage overrun risk index and power flow overrun risk index can effectively quantify the risk of the new type distribution network. Different from the traditional distribution network, the new type distribution network increases the system risk due to the volatility of distributed generators. The risks of different access points and different access capacities are also different. The index system classifies the risks of the distribution network from different angles, facilitates the calculation and analysis of grid security, and provides a quantitative basis for the formulation of safety measures in the distribution network.

articleTitle: Design of Single-Phase AC Electronic Load Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Single-phase AC electronic load is a piece of electronic equipment that can simulate resistive, inductive, and capacitive loads with arbitrary power factor. Due to the rapid advancement of modern control technology, the lag and instability of the traditional algorithm for power factor control cannot satisfy the needs of users. A power factor system based on fuzzy control is designed to address this situation. In the proposed system, STM32 is applied as the main control chip and a fuzzy control algorithm is adopted to adjust the PWM duty cycle, which can achieve flexible control of the power factor. Finally, the verification of the system is carried out by hardware and software design. The experimental results show that the proposed fuzzy controller makes the system fast dynamic response and small steady-state error, which can effectively realize the function of simulated load.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on Comprehensive Model of Enterprise Digital Transformation Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Digital technology is fundamentally changing the operation mode of existing organizations. Enterprises in almost all industries have taken various measures to explore the use of brand-new digital technology to change their key business operations, products and processes, and face the profound changes of technology and market environment in the digital economy era. In this paper, the digital transformation of enterprises is further analyzed based on the improved GA(genetic algorithm), and a comprehensive model is built in this paper. The improved GA can approach the optimal solution within the 10th generation, while the pre-improved GA only approaches the optimal solution around the 35th generation, which shows that the optimization speed of the improved GA is obviously faster than that of the traditional GA. The improved GA ensures that the algorithm converges to the optimal solution quickly and the speed of the algorithm is guaranteed. Digital transformation based on improved GA is defined as the iterative organizational process implemented by enterprises on the basis of data digitization and process digitization. It uses incremental and innovative digital technology to change the organizational structure, process, personnel ability and infrastructure, and helps enterprises develop new business models and core competitiveness in the digital environment.

articleTitle: A Method for Selecting Shape Parameters in Multiquadric Radial Basis Function Interpolation and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: The shape parameters of Multiquadric Radial Basis Function (MQ-RBF) have great influence on its interpolation effect. In this paper, the selection method of shape parameters is studied, and the Random Walk (RW) algorithm is used to determine the shape parameters of MQ-RBF. The principle and steps of parameter selection are given in detail, and the algorithm is tested from the aspects of interpolation effect, iteration times and operation time. Numerical experiments show that compared with other common methods, the algorithm significantly improves the interpolation accuracy of MQ-RBF while ensuring the parameter selection speed. Engineering examples also verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Miner Action Recognition Model Based on Contrastive Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: To address the problems of high training resource consumption and lack of generality in current miner action recognition methods, in this paper, we design a new miner action recognition model based on the multimodal learning framework of contrast learning, which more effectively utilizes the semantic information in the labels and improves the scalability of the model. Then, we use a fixed pre-trained model as the backbone in the video encoder, which greatly reduces the parameters that need to be trained and the resources consumed in the training. At the same time, we design an auxiliary branch to extract temporal information from the video, which effectively improves the accuracy of miner action detection without significantly increasing the computational consumption. Finally, we validate the accuracy performance of the model on the miner action dataset, and its recognition accuracy outperforms other methods in the comparison.

articleTitle: Document-Level Event Extraction via Aggregate Argument Information Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Document-level event extraction (DEE) is extremely important for the events described throughout a long document. Although the existing sentence-level event extraction (SEE) methods are extensively studied, they are not effective due to the challenge of the DEE task: the association between event arguments is not considered in models. This is also one of the hot topics for current DEE research. To address the abovementioned challenge, we propose a method called the Aggregate Argument Information Model (AAIM), which fuses the information of short and long texts and takes advantage of position information of event arguments in sentences and hence captures the interaction semantics among the event arguments to some extent. The experimental results on the large-scale dataset ChFinAnn show that AAIM outperforms the comparison method by 1.0 in F1.

articleTitle: Research on Technical Value Evaluation of Innovation Scenarios from the Perspective of Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Metacosmic technology is gradually changing our daily life. For enterprises and investment institutions, it has become an important issue how to effectively layout the relevant industries of the metaverse and excavate the high-value metaverse scene. This paper combs and predicts different segmentation application scenarios in the fields of metaverse toC, toB, and toG, and evaluates the application value of metaverse segmentation scenarios based on the establishment of three indicators, namely, scenario maturity, scenario market size, and market concentration, and establishes the evaluation system model of metaverse segmentation scenarios, which provides a model index system reference for the construction and development of metaverse.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Technology in Physical Training Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of athletes' training specialization, an improved software for decision analysis and evaluation of sports patterns is designed by using data mining algorithm. This paper expounds the characteristics of association rules algorithm, and describes in detail the effects of data preprocessing, big data mining and pattern evaluation. At the same time, the data preprocessing solution of association rules sports evaluation decision support system is introduced, and the improved Apriori algorithm derivation mode is given, which improves the evaluation effect of system software. By simulating the existing Apriori algorithm, DC-Apriori algorithm tower and the improved Apriori algorithm, it is found that the improved Apriori algorithm can effectively complete the decision analysis of motion patterns.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Simulation Algorithm of Aerobics Formation Transformation Path Based on Matrix Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: At present, the technology of computer simulation has been paid more and more attention by sports science and technology researchers. Whether computer simulation technology can be more effective for sports workers and athletes. On the basis of exploring the transformation path of large-scale aerobics formation, this paper puts forward a path transformation optimization algorithm-minimum path optimization algorithm, and puts forward the solution scheme when the path is contradictory, which provides the algorithm basis for computer simulation. According to the conclusion of computer simulation of formation transformation path of large-scale aerobics, the path planning of each member during formation transformation of large-scale aerobics can be found more intuitively, which provides a good auxiliary means for large-scale aerobics practice. On the other hand applying big data to analyze college aerobics teaching data may assist teachers in better comprehending students' present learning situations and their personal growth and academic achievement.

articleTitle: Solder Joints Accelerated Degradation Model and Life Prediction Method Based on Gamma Process
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: In the rugged fire smoke environment, electronic equipment is easy to be damaged in a short time. Replacing all the damaged equipment will cause tremendous economic losses. As a key component of electronic equipment, the reliability and safety of solder joints after fire becomes an urgent problem to be solved. Therefore, accelerated degradation testing (ADT) is carried out for the solder joints after short-term damage in the fire smoke environment. The results show that the gamma stochastic process can be used to characterize the degradation of solder joints, and the Arrhenius equation can well describe the relationship between temperature and solder joint life. Based on this, an accelerated degradation model combining gamma process and Arrhenius equation was established. Combined with the data of ADT, a two-step method is proposed to estimate the degradation model parameters, and then calculate solder joints life after fire. The predicted life of solder joints is close to the experimental average life, indicating that the proposed method is suitable for predicting solder joints life after fire. It provides theoretical support for the reliability research of electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Study on the Modified Formula of Earth Materials Mixed with Stone and Sand by Montgomery and Voth Single Lattice Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Stone and sand are effective in enhancing the low strength of traditional earth materials, but studies hardly fathom the dimension which conducts test on the composite admixtures based on raw soil. To address this, a study was conducted using the Montgomery and Voth Single Lattice theory as a basis. Specifically, compressive strength tests were performed on 10 formulas and 60 modified raw soil cubic specimens, and the failure process, mode, and strength of the specimens were analyzed. The study also explored the effects of different raw soil formulations on strength, peak displacement, and dispersion, with stone content found to have a prominent impact on peak displacement and dispersion. Ultimately, the optimal modification formula for sand, stone, and raw soil was determined to be 0.15/0.12/0.73 (mass ratio). The study confirmed the suitability of the test approach as a reference for experimental research on modification formulations of earth materials.

articleTitle: SUPExplainer: Subgraph-Level Explanations for Graph Neural Networks via Reinforcement Learning Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Graph neural networks(GNNs) have attracted extensive attention due to their effective applications in various graph tasks[1] [2]. However, GNNs regarded as black-boxes generally meet the challenges of explanation and confidence. To address the above challenge, we propose SUPExplainer, a novel Subgraph-level explanation approach, which can provide a reliable explanation for GNN model. Given an original graph and a trained GNN, SUPExplainer efficiently select the significant subgraphs via Reinforcement Learning(RL) Mechanism to represent the critical structural information of the graph. The model is trained to maximize cumulative rewards through proximal policy optimization(PPO) and acts in an explanation-based environment. However, the system can only receive global rewards, which can not attribute cooperative contributions to different subgraphs. To solve such a problem, we further adopt approximate Shapley value which enhances the sample efficiency and reduces computations. Furthermore, experimental results indicate that SUPExplainer can identify important graph structures in explanation more intuitively, and is quantitatively superior to some baseline methods in reasonable calculation level.

articleTitle: A Current Predictive Control-Oriented Induction Motor Total Loss Hybrid Search Efficiency Optimization Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Symposium on Computing and Artificial Intelligence (ISCAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low operating efficiency of induction motors under light load, low speed and other conditions far from the rated operating point, this paper proposes a hybrid search optimization algorithm based on the total loss model of the motor and the improved fuzzy-golden section algorithm. The reference value of the excitation current dynamic optimization achieves the goal of reducing system losses and improving system efficiency. First, according to the total loss modeling of the induction motor controlled by current prediction, obtain the theoretical value of the excitation current under the minimum power loss; on this basis, the improved fuzzy search and the optimized fuzzy factor are used to improve the global search speed and accuracy of the search algorithm. To solve the problem of the oscillation of the system at the best point, the online golden section method is introduced to improve the local search speed of the system at the best point and reduce the excitation current pulsation and system loss. Simulation and experimental results show that compared with conventional algorithms, the hybrid search algorithm based on improved fuzzy and golden section can effectively reduce the output power of induction motors under the same torque conditions, and the motor operating efficiency is improved. The algorithm has fast convergence speed, dynamic and good steady-state performance and other advantages.
